scope: GTK2 2.24.33 post-R495 scrollbar stepper press/release interaction matrix under four selected KDE color schemes, across separate and GtkSocket/GtkPlug-coupled previews.

environment.scheme_source: Each scheme was read by the native KColorScheme helper from an explicit file; no desktop scheme or user profile was changed.
environment.interaction: For each arrow, captured hover baseline, held left-button state, then released state on the owned GTK2 preview. Compared the 15x15 stepper ROI.

limits: This validates GTK2 interaction and restoration in a private Xvfb; it does not establish historical VUE pixels, actual Xephyr behavior, or human visual acceptance.
Held-state pixel counts are equal across schemes; this test checks state transition and reset, not whether every rendered color changes correctly with each scheme.
No input was sent to either running MAME and no GTK application, desktop theme, or user profile was changed.
next: Continue I167 GTK2 comparison using independent historical/application evidence; retain the separate VM-entry authorization gate where applicable.
